description: Four sound-on-sound loopers sharing one stereo input and output, with a tape-wear section and an XY pad over them

params.text: Sets the depth of the wow and flutter laid over the loops
Sets the tone of the wear applied to the loops
Sets how much of the chosen noise source is mixed in with the loops
Sets the slew on the movements of the XY pad
Sets how much of each buffer is played back
Sets where in each buffer playback begins
Sets the length of the crossfade at the loop point
Picks which of the built-in noise loops that channel plays when nothing has been recorded into it
Sets the playback speed of that channel, and with it the pitch
Arms that channel for recording, and held down erases what is in it
Holds that channel looping rather than playing once
Starts and stops playback of that channel

inputs.text: The left channel of the audio into the loopers
The right channel of the audio into the loopers
Adds to the wow and flutter depth, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
Adds to the wear tone, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
Adds to the noise amount, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
Audio sent out of the noise send jack comes back in here
Moves the XY pad along its horizontal axis
Moves the XY pad along its vertical axis
Adds to the XY pad slew, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
Adds to the buffer size, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
Adds to the buffer position, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
Adds to the crossfade length, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
Picks that channel's source, alongside the knob on the panel
Shifts that channel's playback speed by one octave per volt, added to the knob
A gate above 1V arms that channel for recording
A gate above 1V starts that channel playing, in the way the Play CV Mode menu item sets

outputs.text: The left channel of the mixed loopers
The right channel of the mixed loopers
The signal tapped off for the noise section, for sending through an external effect
The horizontal position of the XY pad as a voltage
The vertical position of the XY pad as a voltage

notes: A channel with nothing recorded into it plays one of the built-in noise loops; to record your own, arm the channel with its record button and feed the stereo input.
menu: HINT: hold control (command on Mac) to keep menu open — a reminder printed at the top of the menu rather than an item that does anything
Save Buffers With Patch — writes the recorded audio into the patch file so it comes back when the patch is reopened
XY Pad Pans Audio — makes the pad position move the four channels around the stereo field
Buffer Size — sets how long each channel can record, from 1 second to 1 minute
Media Type — picks the flavour of wear applied to the loops, from Noise, Cassette, VHS, 8mm Film, 16mm Film, Reel To Reel, Vinyl Clean, Vinyl Dirty and Mic Preamp
GUI — a submenu holding the XY pad's appearance settings: Draw Crosshairs, Cursor Trails, the cursor shape and Wander Speed
Channels — a submenu with a page per channel carrying Continuous Record, Record Source: Main Output, Auto-Play when recording complete and Play CV Mode
